'NMeasuredShells.finite_shell_contraction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

'NMeasuredShells.measurable_shell_contraction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
NMeasuredShells.measurable_shell_contraction.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X]
  (mu : Measure X) (F : Finset E) (p : E → X → ℝ) (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f mu) (hm : ∀ e ∈ F, Measurable (p e))
  (hp : ∀ e ∈ F, ∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ p e x) (hs : ∀ (x : X), ∑ e ∈ F, p e x ≤ 1) :
  ∑ e ∈ F, ‖NMeasuredShells.shell mu (p e) f‖ ≤ ∫ (x : X), ‖f x‖ ∂mu
